description: Apology letter with sincerity checks — Draft a sincere apology letter or email from a situation, then check it offline: owns the mistake, no non-apology phrases (sorry if, sorry for any inconvenience), no blame-shifting, concrete remedy, prevention step, length and reading ease; returns a 0-100 score and issues. Params: situation (required), from, to, remedy, tone (warm|formal). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
